_about: Sounds every game shares, and the launcher music.

sounds._arrangement: 64 beats: A on electric piano and upright bass; A2 with a felt piano tune; B on vibraphone over B flat major 7 to C7; a drumless breakdown.
64 beats: A, guitar, bass and light percussion; A2 with a flute tune; B over F major 7 and F minor 6; A3 with the tune on vibraphone.
64 beats: an 8-bar strain in C, then a trio in F that turns on G7 back to the top. Piano only, stride left hand.
128 beats in D: A on fingerpicked guitar and bass with the tune on marimba; A2 the tune on flute with a shaker; B on chiptune pulse over G, A, F sharp minor and B minor; A3 the flute again.

128 beats in G, a tea-room two-step: A on pizzicato and bass with the tune on harp; A2 the tune on oboe over soft strings; B on chiptune pulse through C, D, B minor and E minor; A3 the oboe over rising harp.

128 beats in E flat, a slow ballad: A on felt piano, bass and brushes with the tune in the piano's right hand; A2 the tune on sax; B through A flat, D flat 7 and C7 with soft strings; A3 the sax again.
64 beats in A minor, for 1 to 5 in the morning: rolled felt piano chords with a sparse tune high in the piano; then the tune an octave down on cello over soft strings.
128 beats in F, a light swing: A on rhythm guitar, walking bass and brushes with a chiptune tune; A2 the tune on piano; B through A7, D7, G7 and C7 on vibraphone; A3 the chiptune again.
96 beats of 3/4 in A minor, a musette: A the tune on mandolin over guitar and bass; A2 on accordion; B in C major on accordion; A3 accordion and mandolin together.
64 beats: A, bass, clav and drums in E dorian; A2 with a lead tune and brass stabs; B over C major 7, D, E minor and B7; a breakdown without kick and clap and a snare roll back in.

sounds._about: Pause music: felt piano and a soft pad, for any game without its own.
